## History

Following the conclusion of the school term, William Bell receives a request from [Stephen Stanhope](../character/stephen-stanhope.md), who unexpectedly arrives during Nell's visit to [Cedric Stanhope](../character/cedric-stanhope.md). [Stephen](../character/stephen-stanhope.md) asks [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to inquire whether he may visit [Rosalind Penrose](../character/rosalind-penrose.md), leading [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to deliver his request to [Rosalind](../character/rosalind-penrose.md) and post the resulting letter.

_Sources: [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P20](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0020), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P21](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0021), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P35](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0035), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P39](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0039)_
